plain_text:
Larry Thor appears in 240 recordings across 11 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1948 to 1957. The credits here include performer, announcer, commercial spokesman, writer, and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear Larry Thor most often in Broadway Is My Beat, Rocky Jordan, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, CBS Radio Workshop, Escape, Suspense, Crime Classics, and Roy Rogers.

Characters credited here include Danny Clover.
